label: H.Res. 1371
title: Expressing support for a "World Sickle Cell Awareness Day" in order to increase public awareness across the United States and global community about sickle cell disease and the continued need for empirical research, early detection screenings, novel effective treatments leading to a cure, and preventative care programs with respect to complications from sickle cell anemia and conditions relating to sickle cell disease.

named.note: No CRS summary is available for this bill yet.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

D000096.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
D000096.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
D000096.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
